name: Profound
description: Profound lets agents read how a brand appears in AI answer engines, including visibility, citations, and prompt data. Each user signs in to their own Profound account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did our brand visibility in AI answers change this month?
Which domains are cited most often in answers about our category?
Compare our visibility with our top three competitors.

apps.name: Profound
apps.description: Visibility, citation, and prompt reporting, over Profound's MCP server with browser sign-in.
